# Deebi Wedding Stories

Deebi Wedding Stories is a wedding photography and cinematography studio owned by Boopathi Raja R.

Location: Surya Nagar, Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India.
Email: click@deebi.com
WhatsApp and phone: +91 95666 21288

Deebi Wedding Stories provides wedding photography in Madurai and across Tamil Nadu, including candid photography, traditional South Indian wedding photography, pre-wedding shoots, engagement and reception photography, Haldi and Mehendi coverage, and cinematic wedding films.

The studio serves couples who want natural emotions, cultural rituals, family relationships, elegant portraits, and professionally edited photographs or films preserved as a visual story.

To check availability, use the booking form on the website or contact Deebi Wedding Stories on WhatsApp.
